name: Hall of Fame 2

dims.source: TC Electronic Hall of Fame manual (identical enclosure) via data/spec_sheets_staging.json (verified): 72 x 122 x 50 mm = 2.835 x 4.803 x 1.969 in; Thomann corroborates. 50 mm adopted as bare-enclosure height (height_includes_knobs unknown in staging; see references/tc-electronic-hall-of-fame-2_measurements.md).

enclosure.notes: Custom compact box: no PRESETS entry matches (Boss compact 73x129x59 mm is 7 mm longer and 9 mm taller). Flat top, rounded corners; per-model dims govern. Colour sampled in references/tc-electronic-hall-of-fame-2_measurements.md (median #A9152A, lit patch adopted).

knobs.note: DECAY top-left of the 2x2 grid. Photo-derived dark-blob centroid in front view, symmetrised to +/-0.66 (see measurements). Black Davies-style knob ~0.66 in dia (mxr body scaled); pointer to the south-west as in the front photo.
TONE top-right, same row/size as DECAY (front + hero34).
LEVEL bottom-left of the grid (front + hero34).
Reverb-type rotary selector (CHURCH/SHIM/MOD/LOFI/1/2/3/ROOM/HALL/SPRING/PLATE arc in the decal), bottom-right of the grid (front + hero34).

led.note: Red LED centred just forward of the mode row, above the HALL OF FAME 2 wordmark (front view lens centroid). Lit in the reference photos.

footswitch.note: MASH pressure-sensitive chrome stomp, centred in the front third (front-view chrome centroid). Press-hold dips the plunger; release toggles the LED (see measurements, MASH behaviour).

toggle.note: PRE-DELAY SHORT/LONG miniature bat toggle between DECAY and TONE (front view). No parts.js builder exists; the hero page builds it from this field (shared-needs list in the build report).

usb.note: Mini-USB (TonePrint) on the back wall, right of the DC jack (plugged cable in hero34/detail views). No parts.js builder; the hero page builds it from this field.

jacks.note: MONO OUT, left wall rear jack (front-view cluster y=307 px; MONO label adjacent). Left = OUTPUT (print-confirmed).
STEREO OUT, left wall front jack (front-view cluster y=382 px).
MONO IN, right wall rear jack (front-view cluster y=306 px). Right = INPUT (print-confirmed).
STEREO IN, right wall front jack (front-view cluster y=380 px).

powerJack.note: 9V DC round barrel centred on the back wall (back view).

labels.note: Silver caps above the DECAY knob (front view).
Silver caps above the TONE knob.
Above the toggle, between DECAY and TONE.
Between the rows, above the LEVEL knob.
Vertical print by the rear left jack (reading bottom-to-top in the front view).
Orange OUT between MONO and STEREO, left wall.
Vertical print by the front left jack.
Vertical print by the rear right jack.
Orange IN between MONO and STEREO, right wall.
Vertical print by the front right jack.

notes: TC Electronic Hall of Fame 2 hero. Custom compact box (72x122x50 mm), flat deck: every deck part (4 knobs, LED, footswitch, labels) seats via surfaceAt() at h=1.969 - no y on any deck part; only side jacks, powerJack and usb carry explicit wall y. 2x2 knob grid (DECAY/TONE/LEVEL/mode selector) measured in two views (front ortho centroids + hero34 fractions, see references/tc-electronic-hall-of-fame-2_measurements.md). Stereo side jacks (MONO rear z=0.05, STEREO front z=0.71; left OUT, right IN), 9V + USB on the back wall. Top print split: mode arc, HALL OF FAME 2 wordmark, MASH/TRUE BYPASS and tc electronic in the decal; knob and side words are vector labels above it. PRE-DELAY toggle and USB have no parts.js builder and are built by tc-electronic-hall-of-fame-2.html from spec.toggle/spec.usb.
